title: Canonical-coefficient transition composition
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring and let a:Y′→Y, b:Y″→Y′, h:Y→S, h′:Y′→S and h″:Y″→S be scheme morphisms [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with a≫h=h′ and b≫h′=h″. For every etale Λ-module sheaf F on Y [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] and integer q, let t be the higher direct image transition [def-sbc-module-higher-image-transitions] and c:(b≫a)^*F→b^*a^*F the pullback composition comparison [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. Then t(b≫a,F) followed by H^q(Rh″_* c[0]) equals t(a,F) followed by t(b,a^*F).

source.place: Tags 09Z1 and 03Q8, canonical comparisons; formal adjunction calculation for these comparisons

proof.text: Prove derived-transition composition by the explicit adjunction hom-set calculation of lowerStarPlusTransition_comp, using derived pullback associativity. This calculation is reproduced as a proved private helper because importing LowerStarPlusTransitionComp would create an import cycle through HigherDirectImage.Transition and HigherDirectImageOverCoherence. Naturality of the unit, counit, and pullback comparison gives naturality of the second transition in the first single-complex comparison.

Use upperStarPlusComp_single for the two pullbacks on F[0]. A generic categorical calculation rewrites naturality of the second transition at the first single-complex comparison, then uses derived-transition composition and the coefficient identity. Postcompose with the direct ordinary pullback comparison to cancel its inverse. Apply degree-q homology, preserving both composites. The final proof compares the mapped equality with the unchanged target through heterogeneous congruence: proof irrelevance identifies auxiliary instance proofs, projection expansion identifies named accessor forms, and Functor.comp_obj identifies successive object applications. This avoids unfolding the large derived single-complex comparison during kernel conversion.

theorem higher_direct_image_transition_core_composition
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {S Y Y' Y'' : Scheme.{u}}
    (a : Y' ⟶ Y) (b : Y'' ⟶ Y') (h : Y ⟶ S) (h' : Y' ⟶ S) (h'' : Y'' ⟶ S)
    (wa : a ≫ h = h') (wb : b ≫ h' = h'') (q : ℤ)
    (F : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    higherDirectImageTransition Λ (b ≫ a) h h''
        (by rw [Category.assoc, wa, wb]) q F ≫
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ q).map
        (R+((h'')_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).map
            ((upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) b a).hom.app F))) =
      higherDirectImageTransition Λ a h h' wa q F ≫
        higherDirectImageTransition Λ b h' h'' wb q
          (((a)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj F)
